act2/after_rats.title: After the Rats
act2/after_rats.body: Dark slime on your heel. A **small victory** — enough to breathe.

choices.text: Mira comments on the rhythm you heard in the squeaking
choices.preview: She respects those who count steps (once).
diaryTexts: Mira: «You counted the squeaking. Whoever listens before leaping lives longer below.»

choices.text: Mira comments on the stench still on your fingers
choices.preview: She recognizes the scent — light friendship (once).
diaryTexts: Mira: «You counted them by smell. I do the same — fewer teeth, more flight.»

choices.text: Mira notices you still smell of flight
choices.preview: No judgment. Only a warning (once).
diaryTexts: Mira: «Flight is not shame. Leaving a trail is. Clean your boots.»

act2/camp/camp_companion_chat.title: Words by the fire
act2/camp/camp_companion_chat.body:
{{companionLine}}

*Someone murmurs the number — **day {{day}}** — like confessing an age.* The fire pops. No one asks permission to listen.

choices.text: Listen to Mira without the stone judging
Mira meets your eyes — someone who recognizes a wall on your shoulder
Mira measures your arcanist silence — she does not judge, she notes
Mira: «The Vigil speaks loud; you listen too softly for it to be mere dogma»
Tomás: «Heavy honor pushes people into holes — are you whole?»
Tomás hesitates: «Tower and dungeon — which eats you first?»
Tomás lowers his voice: «A watchman's faith is serious; do not use it as a wall»
The carved track resonates in the fire — archetype and faction aligned
choices.preview: Legacy: track and faction in harmony.
diaryTexts: By the fire, the echo of your archetype locks into the wall of reputation — the group hears you with a different weight.

act2/camp/camp_mira_fireside.title: Embers — words with Mira
act2/camp/camp_mira_fireside.body:
> *"Speak fast. The fire **hears** better than stone — and I hear better than both."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Ask what she no longer steals from the dark
Speak of the Vigil as one speaks softly
Share silence — only the crackle of wood

act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_shadows.title: What stays in the dark
act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_shadows.body:
> *"I steal what returns my name. The rest I leave **on the ground** — someone will think it treasure. You leave **promises** in the dark; I **know** the weight when you pretend it is light."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Let the matter die in the embers

act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_silence.title: Shared silence
act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_silence.body:
> *"See? **That** is how you make a truce."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Breathe and return to what matters
diaryTexts: Beside the Vigil's fire, Mira and I measured the world in silence — and for once the silence asked no name.

act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_vigilia.title: The Vigil by the fire
act2/camp/camp_mira_topic_vigilia.body:
> *"The **Vigil** likes **order** — order written by whoever survived. Do not trust them. **Use them**."*

{{companionLine}}

act2/camp/camp_tomas_fireside.title: Embers — words with Tomás
act2/camp/camp_tomas_fireside.body:
> *"If you came out of pity, spare the spit. If you came for a **word**, speak — the fire will not interrupt out of manners."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Ask if the shield still weighs
Speak of the order that ceased to exist

act2/camp/camp_tomas_topic_oath.title: Oath without master
act2/camp/camp_tomas_topic_oath.body:
> *"The order did not die in a day — it kept **forgetting** names. As long as you stand before I fall, the **oath** holds."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Leave the past in the embers

act2/camp/camp_tomas_topic_shield.title: The weight of the shield
act2/camp/camp_tomas_topic_shield.body:
> *"It weighs what I **could not** stop. You carry too much as well — do not get used to calling that **honor**."*

{{companionLine}}

act2/camp/manage_equip.title: Iron and oaths
act2/camp/manage_equip.body:
Straps creak. Buckles bite leather. Metal answers with a tired gleam.

Away from the first blow, there is time to set **weapon**, **armor**, and **relics** before you go.

act2/camp/use_consumable.title: Potions at hand
act2/camp/use_consumable.body: Vials knock in your pocket. Each cork is a short **bet** — life, mana, or quiet in the head — then back to the Vigil's fire.

act2/camp/vigilia_camp.title: Vigil Camp
act2/camp/vigilia_camp.body:
Vigil soldiers share dry bread. Honor here tastes of ash.

*With no sun, someone still counts: **day {{day}}**.*

choices.preview: Recover; advance the day.
choices.lockedHint: You need at least 1 supply to pay for rest.

choices.preview: Choose which potion to use.

choices.text: Exchange a few words with the group
Ask the group how many days you have been down
choices.preview: Count aloud; the echo does not lie.

choices.text: Sit by the fire and remember why you descended
choices.preview: The village, the green, the vow — once.

choices.text: Scratch the day into damp earth
choices.preview: An entry in the diary.
diaryTexts: I scratched day {{day}} into the damp earth. The clock above no longer rules.

choices.preview: Inventory and equipment.

choices.text: Report a Cult mark to the officer (−1 cult)
choices.preview: Reputation trade · Vigil slow, Cult immediate (once)
choices.lockedHint: Requires Vigil rep ≥1 and Cult ≥0.
diaryTexts: I spoke too loudly about the Third Bell — the officer noted it as a small victory.

choices.text: The officer notices the wax scar on your wrist
choices.preview: Cracked brazier · Vigil respect (once).
diaryTexts: The officer touched the wax scar: «Whoever pulls a hot seal does not flee the fire — the order remembers.»

choices.text: Rest — the ignored green collects its due (−1 faith)
choices.preview: The crystal you pretended not to see still throbs under the skin.
diaryTexts: On resting, the green pulse collected what I ignored — faith came out thinner.

choices.text: The sentries remember your pair of echoes
choices.preview: Legacy: faction and companion in resonance.
choices.lockedHint: Faction-and-companion legacy still locked.
diaryTexts: An officer murmurs that he has seen you beside the right pair — the camp opens a thread of trust.

choices.preview: Advance the day and return to the crossroads.

act2/catacomb_entry.title: Cross of bones
act2/catacomb_entry.body:
A **crossroads** of thin bones points three ways. Melted candles left **rivers of black wax** on the floor — someone passed not long ago.

The echo lies: one step sounds like three.

choices.preview: Swarm encounter — combat or scouting.

choices.text: Follow the chalk mark on the floor
choices.preview: Armed bones; Kael may be watching.

choices.text: Stop at the crossroads and open the hub
choices.preview: Hub: camp, factions, exploration.

choices.text: Study the ceiling: drips, roots, runes?
choices.preview: Luck check; success reads the floor marks.

act2/catacomb_observe.title: Ceiling
act2/catacomb_observe.body:
**Drips** draw threads in the air. Between the stones, thin **roots** hunt a sun that never comes.

On the ceiling, a **rune** was scraped off and marked with an **X** — someone erased the right way.
act2/catacomb_observe.luckCheckLabel: Read the ceiling without losing your footing at the crossroads

act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual.title: Circle Ritual
act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual.body: A Circle mage scrapes ash on the floor with his thumb. "A light price," he says — and waits.

choices.preview: Accept the ash — or hesitate and withdraw.

choices.text: Sing the refrain as a Circle devotee
choices.preview: More ash, more echo — the day advances.
Mind — keep clarity when refusing (TN 8)

act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.title: Trapped gaze
act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.body:
You step back, but for a moment you **see** the pattern **finish** on your retina — a ghost of a pact you did not ask for.

No mark. An **echo** remains.

act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.title: Quiet refusal
act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.body:
You refuse the **circle** — but the floor pattern pulls your eyes, as if the strokes want to keep going inside you.

To leave whole, you need **clarity**: a straight line in your head that is not his.
act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.skillCheckLabel: Keep your mind steady when refusing the ritual

act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.title: No signature
act2/circle_ritual/circle_ritual_refuse_.body: The ash **stops** at your feet. Nothing is written on you. The silence, this time, is **yours**.

act2/cruzeiro_echo_once.title: Wax and copper
act2/cruzeiro_echo_once.body: Between **two** spent candles, the **wax** kept a **coin** with its face scraped off. Not wealth, not a full lie — only proof someone paid to stay a little warmer.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I pried an old coin from the wax — change from someone who prayed and fled.

act2/encounters/rats_combat_intro.title: Before the leap
act2/encounters/rats_combat_intro.body:
The floor **shakes** — claws digging soft stone. The rats **do not flee**; they advance in an arc, as if someone taught them formation.

Clench your teeth. Combat starts now.

choices.preview: Dice and claws — victory opens the hub.

act2/encounters/skeleton_combat_intro.title: Skull and Rust
act2/encounters/skeleton_combat_intro.body: The skeleton **clicks** as it moves. Dry bone, rusted blade, no hurry.

act2/encounters/trial_fallen_angel_gate.title: Veil trial
act2/encounters/trial_fallen_angel_gate.body:
From the **ash** rises a silhouette that was once too much light for a body. It does not ask forgiveness. It asks for **proof**.

Whoever wants a name of fall, dark, penance, or true aim must beat what fell — and still cuts.

choices.preview: Combat · enemy advantage

choices.text: Face the angel with the arcane (mage)
choices.preview: Combat · enemy advantage
Combat · enemy advantage

choices.text: Face the angel with the arrow (archer)
choices.preview: Combat · enemy advantage

act2/encounters/wild_encounter_bones_rar.title: Bones without choir
act2/encounters/wild_encounter_bones_rar.body: A single **skeleton** rises at the crossing, without chant and without hurry. When it sees you, it points the blade like someone keeping an old oath.

act2/encounters/wild_encounter_cultist.title: Lone patrol
act2/encounters/wild_encounter_cultist.body: An overconfident **cultist** peels off the choir. His voice shakes — not from fear, from cheap ecstasy.

choices.text: Whisper the name of the Third Bell — buy mutual silence
choices.preview: No combat · gold and XP (once)
diaryTexts: The cultist closed his eyes as one hearing distance; when he opened them, he was no longer there — only the rumor of coin.

act2/encounters/wild_encounter_lone_swar.title: Broken nest
act2/encounters/wild_encounter_lone_swar.body: Under loose boards, a **swarm** without a nest runs in circles — wounded, furious, smelling of nest. The hunger still bites.

act2/encounters/wild_encounter_mixed.title: Mixed cell
act2/encounters/wild_encounter_mixed.body: **Rat** and **skeleton** share the same floor. Hunger and bone in one corridor — and you in the middle.

act2/encounters/wild_encounter_rats.title: Double swarm
act2/encounters/wild_encounter_rats.body: Two **vortices** of teeth seal the corridor. Not a people ambush. Organized **hunger**.

act2/faction/circulo_envoy.title: Living ash — Circle
act2/faction/circulo_envoy.body:
**Ash** rises from the floor like cold smoke.

*"The Circle **lends** form," a voice says. "Whoever **tears** pays in cheap blood."*

choices.text: Let the Circle close a favorable symbol
choices.preview: Temporary bonus · MIND
diaryTexts: The ash prickled on my palm and then stilled — a loan from the Circle, with interest in silence.

choices.text: Tear the design before it closes
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation (draft); failure leads to combat.

act2/faction/circulo_envoy_blades.title: Living ash — iron
act2/faction/circulo_envoy_blades.body: Talk is over. The **ash** bites skin. The **Circle** collects with steel what the voice could not.

choices.text: Tear the design before it closes
choices.preview: Combat · bone adept

act2/faction/circulo_envoy_verbal_win.title: Living ash — word
act2/faction/circulo_envoy_verbal_win.body: The pattern **closes** without a bite. You hear the loan fall asleep in the air — held breath, not eternal truce.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The Circle accepted the tone — ash that yields without forgiving for free.

act2/faction/culto_envoy.title: Bell flesh — Cult
act2/faction/culto_envoy.body:
A **bell** without a clapper vibrates in the tunnel's throat. The shadow bends the knee before you do.

*"Devout is who **pays** silence with another silence."*

choices.text: Confess as high debtor — the bell collects and pays
choices.preview: Gold, XP and corruption · cult favor (once)
diaryTexts: The envoy counted to ten in silence and returned my interest in coin and shadow.

choices.text: Accept the price of the Third Bell
choices.preview: +1 faith, +1 corruption
diaryTexts: The bell did not ring — and still the ear bled gratitude.

choices.preview: Verbal confrontation (draft); failure leads to combat.

act2/faction/culto_envoy_blades.title: Bell flesh — iron
act2/faction/culto_envoy_blades.body: The clapper that never came arrives in the **throat**. The **Bell** collects in flesh.

choices.preview: Combat · cultist

act2/faction/culto_envoy_verbal_win.title: Bell flesh — word
act2/faction/culto_envoy_verbal_win.body: The shadow tilts its head. It does not forgive. It only recognizes the debt — and charges another silence.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The rumor drew back — the Bell noted it without bleeding the corridor.

act2/faction/vigilia_envoy.title: Distant beacon — Vigil
act2/faction/vigilia_envoy.body:
A **cloaked watcher** tips the lantern. The metal does not shine — it accuses.

*"Whoever the undercroft names, the Vigil **repeats** softer. **Morvayn** holds the throne; we want him standing — or dead."*

choices.text: Accept military pay and the wrist grip
choices.preview: Temporary bonus · AGI
diaryTexts: A cloak-bearer closed my wrist as one closing a door — and spoke order without sermon.

choices.preview: Verbal confrontation (draft); failure leads to combat.

act2/faction/vigilia_envoy_blades.title: Distant beacon — iron
act2/faction/vigilia_envoy_blades.body: Talk closed. What remains is the count — and the hunter already measures your step.

choices.preview: Combat · hunter

act2/faction/vigilia_envoy_verbal_win.title: Distant beacon — word
act2/faction/vigilia_envoy_verbal_win.body: The lantern drops a finger. No handshake: only barracks truce, cold as metal in the open.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The watcher yielded the step — discipline without blood this time.

act2/flee_rats.title: Flight — teeth in the boot
act2/flee_rats.body:
You slip in **mire** that does not forgive. Bites tear leather where armor does not reach.

The swarm squeals sharp — or maybe only your ear breaks first.

choices.text: Frighten fear itself and return to the crossroads

onEnterDiaryTexts: I fled the rats. The floor remembered my taste — and I left a trail.

act2/flee_skeleton.title: Flight — bones in pursuit
act2/flee_skeleton.body:
The skeleton **does not tire**. You tire. Each click behind you sounds like a question without an answer.

At the bend, a loose bone rolls under your feet.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I ran from a dead thing that walked too fast.

act2/hub_catacomb.title: Crossroads — hub
act2/hub_catacomb.body:
Four corridors open on the **crossroads**. Spent candles drip **wax** on the floor; *today is **day {{day}}** below.*

A bell echo rises from below and dies before the surface. In the air, wet stone and cold metal — the name **Morvayn** sticks to the tongue.

choices.preview: Still squeaking and smelling of nest.
Strange trade; price in gold or secret — rarely appears on the first day.

choices.text: Beacon — Vigil voice at the crossroads
choices.preview: Strong reputation with the order — or open enmity. Once only.
Circle of trust or hostile ash. Once only.
Devotion or rupture with the Third Bell. Once only.

choices.text: Sealed cache — path the beacon showed
choices.preview: Vigil topology · supplies behind the grate.

choices.text: Ash nook — fold the Circle lends
choices.preview: Circle topology · borrowed form.

choices.text: Bell's alcove — door the cult confessed
choices.preview: Cult topology · faith and shadow.
A voice in the shadow offers company.
The Circle charges presence; corruption takes note.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 4+ and a day multiple of 5; the Circle only charges once.

choices.preview: Fire, prayer, and a breath of supply.
Move through the tunnels — stress rises; encounters possible.
Old memory; skill and luck weigh in — the echo weakens if you linger too long.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 7+ and reach by day 10 — after that the echo cools.

choices.text: Cold trail — echo that almost left
choices.preview: There is still a thread; weaker, but present (once).
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 7+ and day 11+; one last time before the stone forgets.
diaryTexts: The echo of oaths had almost vanished — I touched the cold trail before the stone forgot.

choices.text: Study the crossroads: marks on the floor
choices.preview: Read the floor as a map of those who passed before.

choices.text: Pry at candle wax — trapped coin (once)
choices.preview: +1 gold; no combat.

choices.text: Listen to an echo whispering the day
choices.preview: Dry voice at the crossroads; diary entry.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 6+ and still being within the first five days.
diaryTexts: A voice trapped in the ceiling: "You are already on day {{day}}."

choices.text: Climb to the last corridor — dungeon mouth
choices.preview: Brazier, bell, and doorframe; the air outside still listens.
Chapter 3 — the dungeon tightens.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 6+ and reaching the crossroads map goal (patrol).

act2/hub_mira_banter.title: Crossroads — words with Mira
act2/hub_mira_banter.body:
**Mira** rests the sword on her shoulder: "This place **charges** every step. I already left a name here — I will not leave yours for free."

The echo answers. It does not say whose.

choices.preview: You resume the post of decision.

act2/hub_observe.title: Marks
act2/hub_observe.body:
On the floor: **three parallel grooves** and footprints that turn back — someone quit halfway.

Among the marks, **Morvayn** scratched with an arrow down; a rusted **bell** driven into the stone.

choices.text: Talk to Mira about the crossroads
choices.preview: She already knows the price of this floor.
Back to the crossroads.

act2/lore/lore_crossroads.title: Echo of oaths
act2/lore/lore_crossroads.body:
An ownerless **voice** asks what you were and what you accept to be. The air weighs — damp, dense. The stones keep marks of broken oaths.

There is no map here. Only the choice you carry in the flesh.

choices.text: Accept the name of Fallen Knight (knight)
choices.preview: Trial · fallen angel; title only if you win

choices.text: Accept the title of Dark Mage (arcanist)
choices.preview: Trial · fallen angel; title only if you win
Trial · fallen angel; title only if you win
Trial · fallen angel; title only if you win

choices.text: Plunge your arm into the whispering mire
choices.preview: Luck — 2d6 + LCK · without deciding, you return to the crossroads.

diaryTexts: The crossroads reminded me of the name I accepted: fallen, but still standing.
Shadows ask no permission — I gave anyway.

choices.preview: Mind — sustain the memory (TN 8)

diaryTexts: The crossroads reminded me of the distance I chose: not flight — aim.

act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_fail.title: Truncated echo
act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_fail.body: The voice **unravels** before it forms a sentence. You keep the weight without the name — like praying and forgetting the last word.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I tried to recall the penitent; only the cold of stone came to me.

act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_mind.title: Memory that weighs
act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_mind.body:
The echo asks for a **name** — not your baptism one, but the one you chose when guilt sat beside you.

If the memory comes ordered, it may leave more than ash.
act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_mind.skillCheckLabel: Sustain the penitent's memory without breaking

act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_success.title: Confession that stays
act2/lore/lore_penitent_recall_success.body: The memory **settles**. Not as victory — as truth you can hold without lying to yourself.
onEnterDiaryTexts: Every stone here confesses better than I do.

act2/luck_mire.title: The whispering mire
act2/luck_mire.body: The **mire** is not water: cheap memory that promises strength and charges your **luck**. Reach out — the dice decide if you return whole.
act2/luck_mire.luckCheckLabel: Touch the mire without being devoured

act2/luck_mire_safe.title: Thread of luck
act2/luck_mire_safe.body: The mire **releases** your arm as if it lost interest. A lying warmth stays in the muscles — brief, but enough for one more punch.

choices.text: Withdraw and return to the crossroads

onEnterDiaryTexts: The mire gave me a thread of strength — I do not know how long it lasts.

act2/luck_mire_wound.title: Well's bite
act2/luck_mire_wound.body: Something **scrapes** tendon and confidence at once. The pain stays in your stance: the body hesitates before the next step.

choices.text: Drag yourself back to the crossroads

onEnterDiaryTexts: The mire bit my leg. The warmth does not return the same.

act2/merchant/merchant_ask.title: Origin
act2/merchant/merchant_ask.body:
"From an **archive** that no longer exists," he murmurs. "The archive burned. The map survived."

For a second the hood swells — no wind.

choices.preview: Weapon · for inventory

choices.text: Refuse and return to the hub

act2/merchant/merchant_circle_bet.title: Symbols that bite
act2/merchant/merchant_circle_bet.body:
The hood tips for a **wager**. You whisper symbols and the air catches the pattern — someone unseen holds the dice.

*The Circle lends luck; miss the timing and you pay another coin.* **Roll luck** (−1 on fail).
act2/merchant/merchant_circle_bet.luckCheckLabel: Either the Circle pays, or it collects in secret

act2/merchant/merchant_circle_lose.title: Price outside the purse
act2/merchant/merchant_circle_lose.body:
The pattern **slips** one symbol too late. Something pulls from your pocket — not a human hand.

When you see clearly again, **two coins** are gone. A wet laugh echo remains under the hood.

choices.text: Accept the loss and return to the crossroads
diaryTexts: The symbols demanded more than I whispered — two coins gone, and a cold left behind that is not gold.

act2/merchant/merchant_circle_win.title: The hood pays
act2/merchant/merchant_circle_win.body:
The symbols **close** before the curse tightens. A warm coin drops into your palm — paid by the Circle, not yours.

The merchant does not laugh. He only nods.

choices.text: Collect the gold and return to the crossroads
diaryTexts: The hood inclined: the Circle paid in coin — this time the symbols closed in my favor.

act2/merchant/merchant_moon.title: Faceless merchant
act2/merchant/merchant_moon.body:
A **faceless** hood holds out a map with gnawed margins. The fingers under the cloth are too long to be only human.

*"Rumors change **weights**"* — if someone knows you among the factions, the price shifts.

choices.preview: Item · rumor map
choices.lockedHint: You need 1 gold.

choices.preview: Weapon · for inventory
choices.lockedHint: You need 3 gold.

choices.preview: Consumable · reduces stress
choices.lockedHint: Requires 2 gold and level 2+.

choices.preview: Rest is also part of battle
choices.lockedHint: Requires 5 gold and level 3+.

choices.preview: Resource · single stock
choices.lockedHint: Requires 5 gold and level 11+.

choices.preview: A true find
choices.lockedHint: Requires 10 gold and level 20+.

choices.preview: Supply · Vigil seal (once at this stall)
choices.lockedHint: Requires Vigil rep ≥5, 7 gold, and supply ≤7.

choices.preview: Return to the crossroads without buying.

choices.text: Ask where the map came from
choices.preview: Talk; no cost.
Diary · rumor of respect
choices.lockedHint: The Vigil only gives you that hook when reputation with them is strong (≥2).
diaryTexts: The merchant hesitated when I spoke of the Vigil — interest buys silence.

choices.text: Show the rat stench — he recognizes the nest
choices.preview: Scent intel · diary (once).
diaryTexts: The hood inclined: «Three and a shadow. The nest rises when Vigilance falls.»

choices.text: Repeat the surface whisper — he lowers the map price
choices.preview: Torn map without charging gold · once.
choices.lockedHint: You need the surface whisper.
diaryTexts: I repeated the surface whisper; the hood handed over the map without taking copper.

choices.preview: Luck test · cursed wager
choices.lockedHint: The Circle only hears whispers from those who already owe them attention (reputation ≥1).

choices.text: Let the Third Bell name the price
choices.preview: +1 corruption, diary (once)
choices.lockedHint: Requires Cult rep ≥1.
diaryTexts: A dry laugh beneath the cloth — the cult favors those who already hear the same echo.

act2/path_archer_marksman.title: Marksman Archer
act2/path_archer_marksman.body: The **angel** unravels into ash that does not fall — it only drifts away. The arrow does not forgive; neither do you. From here, whoever sees you reads **patience** where they once read shadow.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I defeated the veil angel with the arrow; I accepted the name Marksman — distance as sentence, not as escape.

act2/path_cleric_penitent.title: Penitent Cleric
act2/path_cleric_penitent.body: The incense **burns** thinner when guilt breathes with you. Less psalm. More truth.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The Vigil asks for proof; I offer scars I have already prayed over in a low voice.

act2/path_knight_fallen.title: Fallen Knight
act2/path_knight_fallen.body: The **angel** unravels into ash that does not burn. Iron does not forgive; neither do you. From here, whoever sees you reads **fall** where they once read wall.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I defeated the veil angel with steel; I accepted the name Fallen Knight — not as excuse, but as broken promise.

act2/path_mage_dark.title: Dark Mage
act2/path_mage_dark.body: The angel's broken light feeds what you bring. The Tower measures light; the dungeon teaches what it will not pay. Your notebook gains margins no scriptorium approves.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I tore the fallen angel's veil; the safe symbols grew small. I carry the others in blood and silence.

act2/rats_choice.title: Squeak in the dark
act2/rats_choice.body:
**Squeaking** too loud to be only wind. Ruby eyes in the dark move as a group — not one rodent, a decision with teeth.

The floor is damp; old human prints mix with small paws.

choices.preview: Combat: starving rodents.

choices.text: Listen to the sound before advancing
choices.preview: Intel; light AGI buff if you fight next.

choices.text: Smell the air: blood or mold?
choices.preview: +1 stress; swarm intel and light LCK buff if you fight next.

act2/rats_listen.title: Listen
act2/rats_listen.body:
The squeaking **breaks** into a pattern — almost language. For a moment they seem like whispers counting how many steps remain.

Something larger creaks deeper, but does not move.

choices.preview: Combat with listening advantage (AGI).
Withdraw without combat.

onEnterDiaryTexts: The rats' squeaking almost spoke — I counted steps before advancing.

act2/rats_smell.title: Smell
act2/rats_smell.body:
**Mold** first, then iron — and at last a false sweet, like heated copper.

Not fresh blood. Old blood that never fully dried. You count the swarm by the stench: **three**, maybe **four**.

choices.preview: Combat with scent advantage (LCK); you already paid the stress.
Withdraw without combat — but the scent stays in the diary.

onEnterDiaryTexts: Smell of old flesh and fear: three small bodies, maybe four if the larger shadow counts.

act2/recruit_mira.title: Mira Joins the Group
act2/recruit_mira.body: Mira tightens the sheath. "Less talk. **More feet**."

act2/recruit_offer.title: Mira's Offer
act2/recruit_offer.body: **Mira** watches from the shadows: "I need someone who does not fear the silence."

choices.preview: Commitment in shadow — or silence decides.
choices.lockedHint: With the Circle too deep inside you (rep ≥2), this invitation closes — use the other line.

choices.text: Recruit Mira with the Circle as witness
choices.preview: The web charges visibility — the Vigil grows suspicious.
choices.lockedHint: Only when the Circle trusts you enough (rep ≥2) can you sign with witnesses.
diaryTexts: Mira laughed softly: the Circle likes when someone signs in ash.

act2/skeleton_room.title: Room of Armed Bones
act2/skeleton_room.body: Armed remains rise by **habit**, not will. The blade scrapes dry bone.

choices.text: Trail of iron in the gloom — a silhouette watches, unmoving
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation with Kael (draft); failure leads to steel.

act2/faction/vigilia_cache.title: Sealed Vigil cache
act2/faction/vigilia_cache.body: Behind a **grate** marked with the beacon, a niche holds supplies sealed in wax. Only those who already spoke with the envoy know the path.

choices.text: Break the seal and take what the order hid
choices.preview: Supply and gold · Vigil topology (once).
diaryTexts: The Vigil cache smelled of wax and order — I took what the beacon keeps for those who already gripped the wrist.

choices.text: Leave the seal intact and return
choices.preview: Respect without plunder — the path remains.
diaryTexts: I did not touch the cache. The beacon noted the restraint.

act2/faction/circulo_ash_nook.title: Circle's ash nook
act2/faction/circulo_ash_nook.body: A **nook** the crossroads map does not mark: living ash draws circles on the floor. Only those who already heard the envoy find the fold.

choices.text: Accept the loan of form — read what the ash writes
choices.preview: MIND buff and XP · Circle topology (once).
diaryTexts: The ash wrote a symbol on the palm and then erased it — the Circle lends form to those who already closed a deal.

choices.text: Scrape the ash and leave without reading
choices.preview: No new debt — only the path.
diaryTexts: I scraped the ash. The Circle dislikes those who refuse reading — but also does not charge those who do not open the book.

act2/faction/culto_bell_alcove.title: Third Bell alcove
act2/faction/culto_bell_alcove.body: An **alcove** with no clapper, but the air vibrates. The cult envoy spoke of this fold; the common crossroads does not show the way.

choices.text: Kneel and let the bell name the next step
choices.preview: Faith and corruption · Cult topology (once).
diaryTexts: In the bell's alcove, silence paid in faith and shadow — the cult opens doors to those who already confessed.

choices.text: Turn your back on the alcove
choices.preview: Refusal without combat — the path vanishes.
diaryTexts: I did not kneel. The Third Bell vibrated once — and fell silent.
